_meta._note: Chapter 41, final test (ch41-test, new). Added 2026-10-03 in the proposal harvest, batch 4, from Docs/proposals/chapter-41-content-proposal.md. Twelve multiple-choice questions in six strands of two: gist (q01–02), sequence (q03–04), reference (q05 on a constructed text, q06 on 2:3), phrase meaning (q07–08), textual evidence (q09–10) and the complete readings (q11 Al-Fil, q12 Al-Qari'ah). Two short constructed texts, distinct from the lesson and review texts, are repeated in full on every item that uses them — the player has no shared passage field. Pass mark 80 %: 9/12 fails, 10/12 passes.
